document.slice: P1A.2 — lead records and authorized team inbox

implemented: Lazy-loaded Inbox, Leads and manager-only Settings within Leads & Conversations. Existing Settings remains available.
Manual enquiry creation and editing; published language and enquiry owner/fallback defaults; New, Qualifying, Qualified and Closed stages with reasons for qualification/closure.
Server-side search, filters, sorting and pagination; desktop register/mobile cards. Inbox uses a paged conversation selector rather than a second register table.
Lead detail and immutable chronological activity, bounded 50-event history pages, internal-only notes, human takeover and pause controls.
Optimistic lead/ownership versions, duplicate-create/note protection, stale-response cancellation, preserved failed input and unsaved-edit confirmation.
Assignment changes and closure pause conversations. Manual changes record field provenance and audit summaries.

authorization.tenant: Active signed-in account/company resolves Runtime customer. All Runtime reads/writes use SET LOCAL ROLE sophia_runtime_app and tenant RLS. Fixed company-scoped staff directory uses the identity connection role, projecting IDs and names only.
authorization.managers: Active organisation_owner or existing chief_executive may manage Settings and all tenant leads.
authorization.queueOwners: Published enquiry and fallback owners may manage the tenant lead queue and assignment, without Settings publication rights.
authorization.advisors: Published active advisors access only their assigned leads, including detail, history, notes and ownership. Cannot reassign or take a conversation from another handler.
authorization.contentOwners: Content ownership alone grants neither inbox nor Settings authority.
authorization.revalidation: Active company, active membership and published team access checked on every request; list counts use the same advisor scope as rows.

data.constraints: Tenant-composite foreign keys, optimistic versions, per-tenant request keys, append-only events, forced tenant RLS and explicit least-privilege grants after revoking inherited default grants.
data.identityBoundary: No student account, login, case, invoice, Xero contact, automatic matching or conversion is created.

performance.lists: One scoped CTE query returns count and bounded page; 25/50/100 records, stable ID tie-breakers. Search debounced 250ms with obsolete-request cancellation. No provider calls during ordinary inbox reads.
performance.history: Latest 50 events and cursor-based older pages; replace pages to bound browser memory.
performance.mutations: One refresh after a successful user mutation; stable request keys for safe create/note retries.
performance.limits: No live-volume latency benchmark was performed. Case-insensitive substring searches may need indexed search at larger measured volumes.

verification.backend: 27 focused tests passed across 4 suites, including real disposable PostgreSQL migrations, RLS, tenant-composite FK, least privilege, advisor isolation, stale writes, concurrent duplicate creation, ownership races, internal-note retry, paging, active-member revocation and existing Settings regressions.
verification.realEstate: 38 deterministic tests passed across all 8 test:p0:real-estate suites.
verification.browser: 32 tests passed at desktop 1902x1016 and mobile 390x844, including light/dark layout checks, Settings/navigation regressions, shared controls, request cancellation, retries, unsaved notes and history races.
verification.compile: Application TypeScript and bounded-worker production build passed. Existing bundle/style budget, CommonJS and missing primeicons stylesheet warnings remain.
verification.architecture: Boundary checker exits 1 for the two existing unchanged student-document-analysis.worker.ts/spec.ts vendor-import violations; no new violations.
verification.external: No production database, migration, WhatsApp connection, message, AI request or deployment performed.

deployment: Apply Runtime migration 117 through the normal owner-operated migration runner after 116. Preserve the Runtime app role boundary.
Deploy Business Manager backend and frontend together. Menu registration from P1A.1 is reused; no additional navigation SQL.
Open Leads & Conversations. Publish a valid Settings configuration before creating leads. Verify manager queue access and assigned advisor access.
New conversations remain paused until explicitly taken by a human. This slice has no outbound message control and cannot enable bot ownership.
remaining: P1A.3: official WhatsApp connection through existing integration management; verify Business App coexistence eligibility before onboarding.
Durable verified webhooks, channel identity, inbound/outbound events, opt-out/session-window rules, replay protection, outbox delivery reconciliation and app-message echoes.
Approved agent/knowledge release binding and background turn processing; human takeover must cancel pending automation before transport is enabled.
Real-time status delivery or bounded active-thread polling, human replies, test-number pilot and operational monitoring.
Appointment booked/converted stages require actual booking/conversion actions. Scheduling extension remains P1B.
nextTask: P1A.3 channel transport and inbound pilot; keep live sends and existing-number onboarding separately authorized.
